title: Best CD Account 2026: 5 CDs compared on APY, terms, and early withdrawal penalties
description: Marcus, Ally, Capital One 360, Synchrony, Discover — 1-year CD APY, early withdrawal penalties, no-penalty options, and Bump-up features compared.
lede: Five 12-month CD accounts. $10K deposit each. We tracked APY paid, early withdrawal penalty terms, and no-penalty CD availability.
methodology: $10K opened in each 12-month CD. Tracked actual APY paid, early withdrawal penalty (in days of interest), no-penalty option availability, and customer service responsiveness.

sections.heading: APY and early withdrawal penalties
paragraphs: Synchrony Bank: 4.75% (highest 1-year). Ally Bank: 4.55% + Raise Your Rate option. Marcus Goldman: 4.50% + no-penalty CD option. Capital One 360: 4.00%. Discover: 4.10%.

Early withdrawal penalties: Marcus 90 days interest. Ally 60 days. Capital One 90 days. Synchrony 90 days. Discover 6 months (worst). Marcus and Ally have no-penalty CD options for emergency liquidity.

faqs.q: Are CDs worth it vs high-yield savings?
faqs.a: Yes if you can lock funds for the term. CDs guarantee the rate; HYSA rates fluctuate. With 4-5% APY and rate cuts expected, locking 12-24 months at current rates beats variable HYSA.

faqs.q: What if I need money early?
faqs.a: Choose a no-penalty CD (Marcus, Ally have these — slightly lower rate but free withdrawal anytime). Or build a CD ladder: 4 CDs at 3/6/9/12 months for staggered access.

marcus-by-goldman-cd.review: Best overall. 4.50% 1-year APY, $500 minimum. No-penalty CD option for emergency liquidity. Top-rated service.

ally-bank-cd.review: 4.55% APY, no minimum, Raise Your Rate option. Ten Day Best Rate guarantee on opening.

capital-one-360-cd.review: 4.00% APY 1-year, no minimum, 6mo-60mo terms. App-managed, FDIC-insured.

synchrony-bank-cd.review: 4.75% APY (highest 1-year), $0 minimum. Bump-up CD allows one rate adjustment.

discover-bank-cd.review: 4.10% APY, $2500 minimum. 3-month to 10-year terms. Worst early withdrawal penalty in test (6 months interest).
